speaker: Snow leopard
intro: Another night. The city is awake below me.

decisions.prompt: A new road up the mountain

B.title: Around the gorge
B.detail: With a wildlife crossing under the road

reaction.A: The road cuts my path in two. I wait, and I do not cross.
reaction.B: A quiet way under the road. I can still walk to the other side.

A.title: On the leopard's ridge
A.detail: The lifts climb into her territory

B.title: The ridge stays protected
B.detail: The resort uses an existing slope

reaction.A: Lights on my ridge. Where do I go now?
reaction.B: My ridge stays dark and quiet. Thank you.

B.title: Funded
B.detail: Rangers patrol, cameras watch the trails

reaction.A: The trails are empty. No one is watching over us.
reaction.B: Footsteps on the trail, and eyes that mean no harm. I feel less alone.

decisions.prompt: A herder loses sheep to a leopard

reaction.A: I understand his anger. I am still afraid of it.
reaction.B: A strong corral, and a fair answer to his loss. I am not his enemy now.

ending.title: Your mountains

city.label: City lights
city.low: They stay low, down in the valley.
city.mid: They have crept part of the way up the slope.
city.high: They climb almost to the rock where she sits.

finalLine.faded: There is no room left for me.

ending.hopeful: The real story is hopeful: Kazakhstan's snow leopards have roughly doubled since the 1990s — because people chose B.
ending.measuresHeading: What really protects snow leopards today
ending.note: A simplified story, not a scientific prediction.
